findings.title: Initialization replay does not fully validate receipt discriminators
findings.scenario: Tampering receipt-embedded slots[0].tenantId, audit.tenantId, or audit.projectId is accepted and returned with replayed=true even when durable records remain valid.

findings.title: SQLite event relational columns are not cross-checked against event_json
findings.scenario: Changing domain_events.project_sequence while leaving event_json.projectSequence unchanged is accepted by different-key identical initialization and creates a new receipt.

verification.fullGate: 281/281 passed; typecheck clean; Huly images 14; extension packages 4
customProbes: Memory and SQLite receipt discriminator corruption was incorrectly accepted
SQLite project_sequence column versus event_json divergence was incorrectly accepted and created a receipt

nextAction: Return to Antigravity. Canonically validate every receipt-embedded snapshot, slot, audit, event, and outbox discriminator before replay return; cross-check SQLite domain_events relational columns against parsed event_json in replay and different-key history paths; add Memory/SQLite rejection and zero-new-receipt regressions; rerun targeted and full gates.
